sections.description:
The FFL Checkout plugin by Texas Technology Group is your Second Amendment ally, seamlessly connecting FFLS.com and OpenFFLS.com to WooCommerce for all FFL-required items. Customers can pick their FFL or upload their license—because we believe in making gun ownership and transfers as easy as the Founding Fathers intended.

🧪 DEMO WEBSITE 🧪

Visit the FFL Checkout DEMO website to explore how the plugin works in a real store setup. You can test both the classic WooCommerce checkout and the React-based Checkout Blocks to see how the FFL integration performs in each flow.

🔑 Get Your API Key 🔑

Start selling firearms the right way with smooth, compliant FFL transfers built right into your checkout.
Buy your API key here and get full access to the FFL Checkout Tool.
No fluff, no hassle—just what you need to run a serious online gun store.

Why Choose Our FFL Plugin?

  • ✅ Fast & Easy Checkout – Customers zero in on FFL/SOT dealers with our zip code search and interactive map—because time is ammo.

  • ✅ Our own FFL & SOT Database – Updated daily with verified FFLs/SOTs and downloadable PDFs. No relying on shaky third-party nonsense.  

  • ✅ ATF’s EzCheck – Verify FFL status instantly with a direct link to the ATF’s EzCheck system. Stay compliant, stay armed.

  • ✅ Manual License Uploads – Customers and admins can upload FFL/SOT licenses, fueling our ever-growing, pro-gun database.

  • ✅ Download and Print – FFLs are attached to every order. One click to download or print—ready to ship with your next firearm or NFA item.  

  • ✅ Built by Industry Experts – No overpriced, anti-gun garbage here. We own our servers—100% American, 100% pro-freedom.  

  • ✅ Lowest Cost, Most Features – Just $99.99 per site per year, unlimited queries, unlimited uploads. More features, less cost—boom!

This isn’t just a plugin; it’s a tool to keep the firearm industry thriving. Give customers the freedom to choose, make your job a breeze, and boost sales with lightning-fast checkouts that cut cart abandonment. More guns in hands, fewer hassles—because that’s the American way.

How the Plugin Works

  • At checkout, we serve up a list of FFL dealers for your customers to ship their firearms to—freedom delivered.  

  • No FFL in our database? They upload it; we scan it, and we verify it—building the most badass FFL network around.  

  • You, the store owner, get the chosen FFL’s details and a digital license copy—locked, loaded, and filed.  

  • Every order includes the FFL and a link to double-check its status on EzCheck when it’s time to ship.

When a product screams “FFL required,” our checkout block activates. Customers pick their FFL dealer with an easy search tool—complete with maps and zip code precision—backed by the most accurate, up-to-date FFL data from FFLS.com and OpenFFLS.com. Admins can review every detail right in the order dashboard.

How Much Does the Plugin Cost?

One flat rate: $99.99 per site per year. Unlimited queries, unlimited uploads—all added to our database. No hidden fees, no anti-gun middlemen—just pure value for the 2A community.

Why Is This Plugin Better Than the Rest?

It’s built by gun industry pros and proud 2A supporters—not some random marketing company. Setup is a snap; it is a breeze to use. With our system, you can ditch the overpriced, convoluted systems that others peddle. There are no anti-gun third-party clouds here—we own our servers, our cloud, our destiny. That means no bans, no shutdowns, minimal downtime, and rock-solid performance. Oh, and it’s the cheapest, most feature-packed solution online. Try beating that!

How to Bulk Update Products to be FFL or SOT Required

Want to mark your inventory as FFL or SOT required? Head to your WordPress admin dashboard, hit the product management section, select your goods, bulk edit, and flip the FFL switch. Done—now sell those firearms like a pro.

sections.faq:
Does this plugin support the new WooCommerce Checkout Blocks?

Yes! FFL Checkout works with both the classic checkout and the new React-based WooCommerce Checkout Blocks. You can test both on our demo site to see which one fits your store best.

What happens if a customer doesn’t pick an FFL dealer?

If you enable the “Handle the FFL transfer later” option, customers can skip choosing a dealer during checkout. This helps avoid abandoned carts. You’ll still need to collect the FFL before shipping the item.

What if a dealer isn’t in the database?

No problem. Customers or store admins can upload the FFL license directly at checkout. Our OCR system reviews and adds it to the database, helping it grow and stay accurate.

Can I control where the FFL selection appears on the checkout page?

Yes! You can set the FFL block location from a list of supported hook positions. The default is “before customer details.” Note: not all themes support every hook, so test placement on your site.

What does the plugin cost?

Just $99.99 per site, per year. Unlimited queries, unlimited uploads, no hidden fees, and no anti-gun middlemen.

Can I bulk-apply FFL requirements to my products?

Yes. Use WooCommerce’s bulk editor to mark items as FFL or SOT required. Easy, fast, and perfect for large inventories.

Do I need a separate account with FFLS.com or OpenFFLs.com?

Nope. It’s all handled through our API. Just install the plugin, activate your license key, and you’re ready to roll.

Will this plugin work with my theme?

It works with most standard WooCommerce-compatible themes. If you’re using a custom or heavily modified theme, we recommend testing first—especially with Checkout Blocks.

What’s your refund policy?

We’re 2A businesspeople, not software tyrants. If something doesn’t work as expected and we can’t fix it, we’ll make it right. Just contact us directly.
